featured.title: Midday Vibes
featured.shortDescription: The vibrant heartbeat of Lagos daytime radio. Packed with heavy music rotations, hilarious audio bytes, trending comedy, and live listener shoutouts.
featured.fullDescription: Midday Vibes brings the authentic sounds and street rhythms of Lagos straight to your airwaves. Hosted by Simi Ogunleye, enjoy heavy Afrobeats rotations, infectious comedy segments, trending audio soundbites, and live interactions across every area in Lagos.

Monday.title: The Early Momo Show (Part 1)
Monday.description: Wake up Lagos with high voltage morning gbedu, early morning news alerts, and motivational energy.
Monday.fullDescription: The Early Momo Show (Part 1) sets the pace for your weekday mornings. Featuring Rise and Shine morning mantras, High Voltage Gbedu playlist mixes, and the First Alert news bulletins to prepare you for the day.

Monday.title: The Early Momo Show (Part 2)
Monday.description: Hard-hitting street discussions, Lagos traffic updates, civic parliament, and hot breaking news.
Monday.fullDescription: The Early Momo Show (Part 2) brings prime-time morning radio alive with As E Dey Hot!, Citizens' Parliament, Chakam! viral gossips, Who Talk True fact checks, Everyday Hero spotlights, and real-time live Lagos traffic reports.

Monday.title: Midday Vibes
Monday.genre: Sounds of Lagos: Music Heavy & Comedy
Monday.description: Midday energy packed with continuous Afrobeats hits, hilarious audio comedy bytes, and street anthems.
Monday.fullDescription: Join Simi Ogunleye for Midday Vibes: non-stop Sounds of Lagos, music heavy soundtracks, entertaining audio bytes, comedy drops, and listener interactions to power your workday.

Monday.title: Area Workchop
Monday.description: Lively afternoon bridge featuring Kedu Lagos!, high-voltage gbedu, on-air freestyles, and vibrant comment sections.
Monday.fullDescription: Area Workchop seamlessly transitions Lagos from midday into drivetime. Hosted by DJ Tobi, featuring Kedu Lagos! community voices, High Voltage Gbedu & Freestyle battles, and fiery reactions in The Comment Section.

Monday.title: Area Drivetime-Cruise (Part 1)
Monday.description: Lagos rush hour made entertaining with deep confessions, real-time traffic jam surveillance, and bus park reporter networks.
Monday.fullDescription: Area Drivetime-Cruise (Part 1) is your ultimate evening traffic survival companion. Tune in for Traffic Jam Traffic updates, emotional listener Confessions, Korope Konnect stories from bus drivers and conductors, and our grassroots Reporter Network.

Monday.title: Area Drivetime-Cruise (Part 2)
Monday.genre: Area Sports: Sure Odds & Fan Wars
Monday.description: High-octane sports analysis, Sure Odds predictions, fan debates, local champions, and Wetin Sup Today?
Monday.fullDescription: Area Drivetime-Cruise (Part 2) brings raw sporting passion to the air. Join Babalola Alabi and DJ Tobi for Area Sports breakdown, Sure Odds insights, heated Fan Wars, grassroots Local Champions highlights, and the daily recap: Wetin Sup Today?

Monday.title: Late Night & Overnight Cruise
Monday.genre: High Voltage Gbedu & Night Mood Matrix
Monday.description: Overnight music sanctuary featuring nonstop high-voltage mixes and our signature 6-Day Mood Matrix.
Monday.fullDescription: Late Night & Overnight Cruise takes you into the dawn. Hosted by Kemi Adetiba, featuring continuous High Voltage Gbedu, soothing soul rhythms, deep Afro-house and the Area Night Cruise 6-Day Mood Matrix.
Monday.targetAudience: Night Owls, Creatives, Security & Late Workers
